provenance.instrument: Amity Township Zoning Ordinance of 1991 (Chapter 32 Zoning, Ord. No. 130 of 12-9-1991, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 AM1620, Township of Amity, Berks County. Chapter 32 was adopted 12-9-1991 by Ord. No. 130. Family member suites were added by Ord. No. 311 (2-6-2019) as 32-957 and listed in RC, LDR, MDR, RV and PBOI. The accessory structure rules were last amended by Ord. No. 343 (12-18-2024). New Laws lists Ord. No. 353, 354 and 355 (2026), none of them on zoning. The only attachment is the Zoning Map. Every district article sets its uses and figures in the text
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 code version 2026-03-18. New Laws (3), none on zoning
checks: Family member suites are 'a use permitted by right in the RC (Rural Conservation), LDR (Low-Density Residential), MDR (Medium-Density Residential) and RV (Rural Village - Amityville) Zoning Districts' (32-957(c)(1))
A family member is a 'Father, mother, parent-in-law, step-parent, grandfather or grandmother' of the person living in the main dwelling, at most two people (32-957(a), (e)(3))
'Family member suites are restricted to single-family dwellings and are not permitted in accessory structures' (32-957(e)(1))
'The family member suite shall not contain more than 800 square feet of floor area, no more than one bedroom and shall be attached to the primary residence' (32-957(e)(10))
Utilities are shared, no separate mailing address, and a way between the house and the suite must always exist (32-957(e)(4), (9), (11))
The zoning permit is renewed every two years with proof that a family member still lives in the suite (32-957(e)(6))
One off-street space beyond the two the house needs (32-957(e)(8), 32-924(c)(1))
In PBOI a suite needs a conditional use from the Board of Supervisors and is allowed only in a nonconforming dwelling that existed on 2-6-2019 (32-408(c)(4), 32-957(d))
MHP permits a single-family house but does not list family member suites (32-404)
Conversion of a large single-family house to two units is a special exception in RC, LDR, MDR and RV (32-904)
Dwelling types and uses not accounted for in the chapter are heard by the Board of Supervisors as a conditional use (32-949)

Residential accessory buildings: at most 20 ft tall, not in a required front or side yard or within 10 ft of the rear line, and at most 500 to 1,728 sq ft by lot size (32-902(a)(1), (b)(7), (b)(9)). These do not reach a suite, which may not be in an accessory structure
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Amity Township, Zoning Officer. Read in a browser on eCode360, one page at a time, on 2026-11-15, in print view. Searched the code (scope all) for accessory dwelling, in-law, accessory apartment, accessory suite, ECHO, elder cottage, granny, guest house, carriage house, tenant house, living quarters, second dwelling, conversion, two-family, caretaker, farm dwelling, relative and relative quarters. Hits were 32-957 (family member suites), 32-904 (conversions), 32-933 (two-family developments), 32-902 (caretaker quarters) and the definitions. Read: Part 3, every district section in Part 4 (32-401 to 32-409), 32-507 (Route 422 Overlay), Part 6 (cluster), 32-902, 32-904, 32-911, 32-924 in part, 32-933, 32-949, 32-957, Part 10 and 32-1105. Read in part: 32-202 definitions (through 'Transitional-age development', not 'Use' onward). Not read: Part 1, 32-502 to 32-506 (environmental overlays), Part 7 (PRD), Part 8 (mobile home parks), the other Part 9 sections, the rest of Part 11 and the Zoning Map. Lot coverage counts buildings only. The Route 422 Overlay is a development option for tracts of 50 acres with 300 ft on Route 422 and allows only townhouses, twins and apartments as homes (32-507). The district sections allow 'a single principal use' and list family member suites among those uses.

term.note: 'Family member suites in new and existing single-family dwellings for aging or ill family members' (32-957(b))

status.note: Only family members of the person living in the main dwelling, at most two. By right with a zoning permit renewed every two years in RC, LDR, MDR and RV, and by conditional use in PBOI

status_outside.note: MHP, HC, SCC and LI/O do not list family member suites. MHP permits single-family houses, the others list none

status_by_form.note: 'Family member suites are restricted to single-family dwellings and are not permitted in accessory structures.' The suite 'shall be attached to the primary residence'

path.note: Zoning permit and building permit from the township, then a certificate of use and occupancy. No hearing. The zoning permit is renewed every two years

fallback_path.note: Zoning Hearing Board on the five findings of 32-1105(a). No section read bars a use variance. A variance lapses after one year if the work does not start

value.note: Board of Supervisors conditional use, only in a nonconforming residential dwelling that existed on 2-6-2019 and meets 32-1005

unlisted_use_path.note: 'All proposed dwelling types and uses which are not accounted for in this chapter shall be considered by the Board of Supervisors and the Township Planning Commission as an application for a conditional use.' The Planning Commission first decides whether the use is a variation of a permitted use or an exotic use. Family member suites are accounted for in other districts, so whether 32-949 reaches one in MHP, HC, SCC or LI/O is not settled

unlisted_use_scope.quote: Other dwelling types or uses, not specifically or adequately identified within this chapter

value.name: Conversion of a single-family detached house into a dwelling for two families (RC, LDR, MDR, RV)
value.conditions: 'The Zoning Hearing Board may authorize as a special exception the conversion of any single-family detached dwelling into a dwelling for not more than two families' in RC, LDR, MDR or RV (32-904(a)). 'The lot area per family shall not be reduced to less than the minimum lot area per family', and the district yard and other rules are not reduced. Water and sewage must meet DEP rules. 'Such conversion shall be authorized only for a large building which has relatively little economic value or usefulness as a single-family detached dwelling or other conforming use.' The Board may add conditions. Two off-street spaces per dwelling unit (32-924(c)(1))

requires.condition: A large building with relatively little economic value or usefulness as a single-family detached dwelling or other conforming use

value.note: The code does not define the minimum lot area per family. The lot figure is read as twice the district minimum lot: in MDR and RV with public sewer and water, 60,000 sq ft with public sewage only, 160,000 sq ft with on-lot sewage and water

value.name: Two-family detached dwelling development (MDR, MHP)
value.conditions: 'Two-family detached developments are permitted by special exception in the MDR (Medium Density Residential) and MHP (Mobile Home Park) zoning districts' (32-933). A two-family detached dwelling (duplex) has two units 'separated by horizontal floors as opposed to vertical walls' (32-202). Net lot 20,000 sq ft with public sewage and water, 60,000 sq ft with public sewage or water, 2 acres with on-lot facilities. Front 40 to 50 ft, rear 30 to 40 ft, sides 20 to 30 ft, coverage 30% (20% on-lot), height 35 ft
value.note: The code speaks of a development, and does not say whether one two-family building on one lot, or adding a unit over or under an existing house, qualifies

value.name: One residential unit in a dual-use building with a ground-floor business (RV)
value.conditions: 'Single family residential dual-use, when arranged to form an integral part of a building in which the ground floor, or where a minimum of 50% of the ground floor thereof, is constructed and maintained for any use permitted under Subsections (b)(5) through (b)(20) herein. With such a dual-use, there shall be one residential unit permitted, regardless of lot size' (32-409(b)(4)). Parking is met for each use separately. Nonresidential lot figures apply: 20,000 sq ft with public sewer and water, 40,000 sq ft with public sewage only, 80,000 sq ft on-lot (32-409(d)(2))
value.note: The host is a business building, not a house

value.name: Caretaker or owner residence with a commercial use (HC, SCC)
value.conditions: Accessory uses in HC include 'residential use occupied by the caretaker or owner of a commercial use located on the same lot' (32-405(b)(13)). SCC permits every by-right HC use (32-406(b)(1)). In commercial and industrial districts 'Living quarters are permitted only for proprietors, watchmen, caretakers or similar employees' (32-902(c)(3))
value.note: The host is a commercial use, not a house. HC and SCC list no house

districts_read_no_listing.note: MHP permits single-family houses (MDR figures) and two-family and twin developments by special exception. HC and SCC allow a caretaker or owner residence with a commercial use. LI/O lists no dwelling

value.condition: Only family members of the person living in the main dwelling may live in the suite, at most two people. A family member is a 'Father, mother, parent-in-law, step-parent, grandfather or grandmother'. The suite may never be rented out as an apartment.

Only in a single-family dwelling. Not in an accessory structure. The code names the twin a 'single-family semi-detached dwelling' but defines it as a building for two families, so whether a twin qualifies is not settled.

The suite has its own cooking, sleeping, living and bathroom facilities, at most one bedroom and 800 sq ft, and is attached to the main residence. A separate entrance is allowed, but a way between the house and the suite must always exist. Electric, plumbing and heating are shared, with no separate utilities and no separate mailing address.

A zoning permit and a building permit, then a certificate of use and occupancy. The zoning permit must be renewed every two years by showing a family member still lives in the suite. The certificate ends six months after the use stops, and the space must then go back to the house or have its kitchen removed within six months.

In PBOI only in a nonconforming residential dwelling that existed when 32-957 took effect, meeting 32-1005 too. The code shows only the adoption date of Ord. No. 311 (2-6-2019), read here as that date.

A lot inside a cluster development (by right in LDR, conditional use in MDR, a 10 acre tract) follows the cluster figures: 20,000 sq ft with public sewer and water or 43,560 sq ft without, front 30 or 40 ft, rear 20 or 30 ft, sides 10 or 20 ft (20 or 40 ft together), coverage 25%.

max_sqft.note: Floor area. At most one bedroom

internal_uses_district_height.note: The suite is part of the house, so the principal building height applies

occupancy.value: Family members (father, mother, parent-in-law, step-parent, grandfather or grandmother) of the person living in the main dwelling. At most two people. Never rented as an apartment.

owner_occupancy.note: The code ties the suite to the family of 'the individual residing in the principal dwelling unit'. The owner applies for and renews the permit. It does not say in words that the owner must live there

max_adus.note: The code speaks of 'a family member suite' and 'the family member suite' but sets no number

spaces_required.note: 'One additional off-street parking space must exist or be created in addition to the off-street parking required for the principal dwelling unit'

total_on_site.note: Two spaces per dwelling unit for the house plus one for the suite

min_lot_sqft.note: Width 200 ft. One set of figures for every lot, whatever the sewer and water service. Net lot area, which leaves out street rights-of-way, Environmental Protection Overlay areas, common open space and utility or stormwater easements (32-202). A lot of record below the minimum may be used for a permitted use if the yards, height, coverage and open space rules are met (32-1002)
